name: PT Link Net Tbk
summary: PT Link Net Tbk distributes television programmes and high-speed internet services through its broadband communication network in Indonesia. The company offers broadband internet connections and cable TV for residential customers; and connectivity and integrated communications technology solutions, as well as sales of advertising time or slots, IT managed services, and sale of equipment for enterprise customers. It also provides broadband services; subscription broadcasting and outsourcing; and communication system, network access point, multimedia, telephony value added, and telephony internet services for public purposes, as well as trading, management consultancy, and call center services…
